name: Sashino Shuri
source:
Shuri's a boy whose cute appearance and smile makes him popular. Apparently, he is occasionally mistaken for a middle school student. He belongs to the radio club, and is its only member (it's unknown why the club still exists). When he gets in a bad mood, his black-hearted tendencies surface.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/syuri.html]official website profile[/URL].]
